name: Modern Steels Ltd
about: Established in 1974, Modern Steel Ltd. manufactures low-alloy and carbon-steel-rolled products for commercial vehicles, such as trucks and tractors, passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, and engineering companies.
keyPoints:
Products Portfolio:[1]
The company manufactures Steel Rolled products consisting of Alloy Bars / Rounds and Non Alloy Bars / Rounds.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 69.0%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.83 Cr.
